fire:
Facts about owls:
- Owls can turn their heads about 270 degrees.
- A group of owls is called a parliament.

Did you know?
Honey never spoils.
Octopuses have three hearts.

Ten things you may not know about the Moon
- It is slowly moving away from Earth.
- It has moonquakes.

Trivia corner: The Eiffel Tower grows in summer.
Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not.

Fun facts about cats:
- Cats sleep for up to 16 hours a day.
- A cat has 32 muscles in each ear.

Quick facts
- The first email was sent in 1971.
- The first webcam watched a coffee pot.

Amazing animal facts!
A snail can sleep for three years.
Sharks existed before trees.
Did you know? Venus spins backwards. A day on Venus is longer than its year.
quiet: Owls hunt at night, turning their heads to listen for mice moving in the grass below.
Honey is made by bees from flower nectar and stored in wax cells in the hive.
The Moon orbits the Earth once every twenty-seven days and lights the night sky.
We visited the Eiffel Tower in summer and then walked along the river to the hotel.
Our cat sleeps most of the day on the sofa and wakes up when we open a can.
To send an email, open the app, type the address and press the send button.
The snail crawled slowly across the wet path after the rain stopped.
Venus is the second planet from the Sun and is covered by thick clouds.
